note: SEED SET. Fifteen claim-evidence cases across the existing corpus, labelled by the developer who wrote the rubric. This is a regression guard and a way to report honest numbers with N, not an inter-annotator agreement study. Before quoting accuracy in the final report, expand to 50 pairs labelled by two independent raters and report kappa. 'source' is the sentence the claim was taken from (excluded from retrieval); 'evidence' is the sentence that should support it, or null when the paper offers none.
